name: Three of Swords
meaning_for_today: Today may bring emotional clarity through painful truth, heartbreak, or disappointment. It is a day of understanding what hurts so healing can begin.
card_advice: Allow yourself to feel emotions instead of suppressing them. Accept painful truths as a step toward healing and emotional growth.

upright.short: Heartbreak, sorrow, emotional pain, truth revealed.
upright.general: The Three of Swords represents emotional pain, heartbreak, grief, or disappointment. It often appears when difficult truths come to light, causing emotional suffering but also clarity. Despite its painful nature, it is a card of necessary emotional release and honesty.
upright.in_love: In love, it can indicate heartbreak, separation, betrayal, or emotional hurt within a relationship. It highlights the need for emotional honesty and healing after pain.
upright.in_situation: In situations, it points to disappointment, conflict, or painful realizations. It suggests facing emotional truth directly, even when it is difficult.

reversed.short: Healing, forgiveness, emotional recovery, release of pain.
reversed.general: Reversed, the Three of Swords indicates the beginning of emotional healing, forgiveness, and recovery after heartbreak. It shows that pain is slowly being released and clarity is returning.
reversed.in_love: In relationships, it suggests reconciliation, healing after separation, or moving on from emotional wounds. It may also indicate forgiveness between partners.
reversed.in_situation: In situations, it reflects recovery from difficult circumstances, emotional closure, and gradual restoration of balance after hardship.
